summary: Both letterless stems the requirement forbids — pure digits '12345' and digits-with-hyphen '123-45' — are run through the real parseSpec and asserted to raise rule REQ-011.1.3 specifically; the inverse direction (a letter-bearing stem not tripping it) is not asserted inside this test, but the same file's REQ-011.1.1/2.8 cases assert violations.toEqual([]) for codex-session-scrollback, so an always-flag implementation would still fail the suite.
